decisions.statement: Every tile draws this one ring.
A ring draws the reading the ring is handed and fetches nothing.
A caption handed a moment counts down to that moment in place of its words.
A caption counting down is left to redraw itself rather than spelled as text.
A caption counting down is written in the form the caption names.
A caption is centred in its own width rather than sitting at one edge of it.
A ring with nothing left keeps its own words rather than counting.
A moment already gone is counted up from rather than held at nothing.

definition: the circle a reading is drawn on
